name: Aru Natsu no Monogatari
source:
It is a hot summer. Main character overhears girl's secret and decides to spend vacations alongside her. One day an unexpected event happens... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
炎熱的夏天，主角偶然聽到了一個女孩的秘密，決定與她一起度過假期。某一天，意想不到的事情發生了……
